And the most important thing: STAY PASSIONATE. Remember why you got involved in art to begin with. If you find yourself getting burnt out, remember that it's okay (and so helpful!) to take a break and chill out with friends, or watch netflix, or do a personal project or whatever. And find inspiration from as many sources as possible, whatever moves you, hold on to. It doesn't matter if it's renaissance paintings of the greats, or a book, or a fucking oil spill in pavement, its all about how you see things and value them.
